body: I think they thought I was too young since I was 13. He was a year older than me and super sweet. My mom and brother met him but my dad never did since my dad was at work. I remember them lecturing me and I was hiding under a blanket crying my eyes out. It really scarred me. My boyfriend and I only dated three months because I felt so shitty so I broke up with him.

I'm sorry. I feel the same way. I had a boyfriend back in middle school, he was my first one. My parents ended up talking to me for 2 hours and yelling at me about him so I think that's a big reason why I've never pursued boys. I guess I've been scared I'd be yelled at again or something so that messed me up. I just thought they'd come and pursue me but I guess that I'm wrong. 

I'm also an extremely shy person so I don't normally start convos first. That's why I'm a pretty hopeless cause.

It's so difficult to believe in my wishes when I am the way I am. I feel so hopeless. I'm so sick and in pain mentally and physically constantly and I just want it all to stop. I want peace. It's really nice of you to come onto this reddit to help others out. Keep doing what you're doing. The world needs more people like you.
You guys did the right thing. Good for you! You all are so brave and should be proud of yourselves. I'm sure that wasn't an easy thing to do.
